name: The Boss
description: Eliseo is the superintendent of an upscale building. On the surface, is cordial and docile in his role, but underneath Eliseo believes himself the omnipotent figure of the community — meddling in the affairs of residents and pulling strings as he sees fit. Eliseo's only concern is protecting his job, which comes under threat by a proposed pool project.

videos.title: A Dangerous Project
videos.overview: Superintendent Eliseo learns about a project that would result in him losing his home and job.

videos.title: A Sympathetic Move
videos.overview: Eliseo manipulates a case of infidelity and plays on a woman's faith in a bid to secure allies.

videos.title: A Tourist in Buenos Aires
videos.overview: Eliseo must run off a Swiss tourist after the owners of the apartment he rented her return early.

videos.title: A Lover for Zambrano
videos.overview: Eliseo employs drastic measures to destroy his adversary's marriage.

videos.title: Surprise Visit
videos.overview: The arrival of a suspicious character at the condominium forces Eliseo to investigate.

videos.title: Night Driver
videos.overview: Eliseo is ensnared in a blackmail scheme by the daughter of a menacing union leader.

videos.title: Therapeutic Companion
videos.overview: After efforts to help a tenant's depressed son backfires, Eliseo tries to undo the good he's done.

videos.title: Sabotage in the Engine Room
videos.overview: Eliseo's latest plan to derail the pool project plunges the building into a dark chaos.

videos.title: The Squatter in 5B
videos.overview: Eliseo digs deep into his bag of deception to secure the three votes needed to block the project.

videos.title: The Moment of Truth
videos.overview: A last-minute betrayal allows the passing of the pool project, sending Eliseo into a dark place.

videos.title: The Phoenix
videos.overview: Eliseo returns to the building during an emergency that transforms him into a hero.

videos.title: A Woman of Solidarity
videos.overview: The arrival of a new neighbor to the building jeopardizes all of Eliseo's achievements.

videos.title: An Unexpected Alliance
videos.overview: Eliseo and Zambrano join forces and infiltrate Lucila's NGO to sabotage it.

videos.title: Just a Little Scare
videos.overview: Eliseo recruits his nephew Maxi to stage a fake robbery to scare Lucila away.

videos.title: The Last Goodbye
videos.overview: An unexpected death leaves Eliseo and the consortium devastated.

videos.title: Surprise Occurrence
videos.overview: Eliseo runs for the Board of Owners.

videos.title: Medical Assessment
videos.overview: Eliseo faces a psychiatric examination that threatens to expose his complex psyche.

videos.title: Olives for Everyone
videos.overview: Eliseo goes on a rural expedition to learn more about Lucila's secret past.

videos.title: The Convention
videos.overview: Eliseo attends a convention and decides what his next professional move will be.

videos.title: Basurto Integrated Solutions
videos.overview: Eliseo puts into motion his plan to take over all the buildings in the neighborhood.

videos.title: Well Then...
videos.overview: Eliseo faces some detractors. A surprise visitor stirs up his troubled and painful past.

videos.title: A Second Chance
videos.overview: Eliseo decides to immerse himself into tantric meditation to help him complete his next mission.

videos.title: A Peck on the Lips
videos.overview: An old enemy from Eliseo's past resurfaces.

videos.title: Supercide
videos.overview: Eliseo must take over one more building to have full control and comes up with a master plan.

videos.title: Eliseo Versus the Argentine State
videos.overview: Eliseo defends himself before a court of law so that he doesn't lose his business or face jailtime.

videos.title: A Million Bucks
videos.overview: Eliseo gets to the highest circles of power, but Zambrano is back for revenge.

videos.title: Basurto Operation
videos.overview: Eliseo becomes the President's confidant, as Zambrano plots to throw him out of the building.

videos.title: Restraining Order
videos.overview: Eliseo makes more enemies. Zambrano goes ahead with his plan and makes a master move.

videos.title: Flat Broke
videos.overview: Eliseo hits bottom and is more vulnerable than ever. Zambrano gets ready to strike his final blow.

videos.title: The Heir
videos.overview: Eliseo returns to the building, but his inner circle's greed unleashes a new power game.

videos.title: The Last Wish
videos.overview: Eliseo plans his funeral and makes peace with Zambrano. But he gets involved in a new plot.

videos.title: The Bosses' Heaven
videos.overview: Neighbors say goodbye to Eliseo, without imagining that one last surprise awaits them.
